assets.content:
PRESS PDF — Ironline Forge casting spec card 2025 (single-sided leave-behind, A6 portrait 105 x 148 mm, 3mm bleed, fonts embedded). The file the printer used. To be reverse-engineered into a live InDesign merge template.

VISUAL STRUCTURE (top to bottom):
1. PHOTOGRAPH FRAME — a graphic frame occupying the top ~50% of the card, a tinted photograph of the casting.
2. CASTING REFERENCE — one short line, grotesque, small caps, e.g. 'IL-108'. (This is the run the converted story readout drops while keeping its trailing line break.)
3. CASTING NAME — one or two lines, editorial serif, large, e.g. 'Warehouse Bracket'.
4. ALLOY & FINISH LINE — one line, grotesque, e.g. 'Cast iron - blackened and waxed'.
5. WEIGHT & LEAD-TIME LINE — one line, grotesque, e.g. '12 kg - 8 weeks'.

MERGE FIELD LABELS (to be mapped from ironline_castings.csv):
<<reference>>  ->  CASTING REFERENCE block
<<name>>  ->  CASTING NAME block
<<alloy>> and <<finish>>  ->  ALLOY & FINISH LINE (composed 'ALLOY - FINISH')
<<weight>> and <<lead_time>>  ->  WEIGHT & LEAD-TIME LINE (composed 'WEIGHT - LEAD_TIME')
<<image>>  ->  PHOTOGRAPH FRAME (bound through the @-prefixed image column)

NOTE FOR THE PRINTER: iron black ink #1A1A1C, numbers set plainly, never as a promotion. Card trim 105 x 148 mm. The editorial serif is used only for the casting name.

assets.content:
IRONLINE FORGE — story & panel copy (client-supplied, approved)

GROUND
The brand story page and all stand panels sit on our dark ground: iron black #1A1A1C. The maker's mark reverses out of it. Cut-outs and the mark are judged on THIS colour, not on white.

PALETTE
Iron black #1A1A1C / Furnace orange #C6591F / Cast bronze #7A5A2E / Ash grey #6E6E6B / Foundry sand #C9BCA3.

BRAND STORY (body text)
We have cast iron and bronze in this building since 1911. Every piece is poured, cooled, finished and regulated by hand, and struck with our maker's mark before it cools. We sell permanence: the heat, the hands, and the fact that the piece will still be here in eighty years.

STAND PANEL
Headline: 'Cast to outlast the building.'
Standfirst: 'Iron and bronze, cast in this building since 1911. Bespoke architectural work for people who build to last.'
Physical size: 850 mm wide x 2200 mm tall (portrait roll-up banner), full bleed. This is the one placement where the set may run out of pixels.

SOCIAL CAPTION
'The mark goes in before the metal cools. Every piece, since 1911.'

DELIVERED SIZES (all three in ONE editable file, each keeping its own canvas)
- Stand panel: 850 x 2200 mm at true physical dimensions.
- Brand story page: 1280 x 1600 px web hero.
- Social canvas: 1080 x 1080 px.

BAND & AUDIENCE
Bespoke castings $5,000-$60,000 a piece. Specifiers, architects and developers 40-65 buying provenance. Plain, declarative, never promotional.

MARK
There is no artwork for our maker's mark anywhere. It exists only struck into the metal, and it has to work small on a spec card and reversed out of the dark. Tell us plainly where it holds and where it does not.
